title: movement_indicator_none_test placeholder assertion is now vacuous
detail: The em-dash to hyphen substitution makes string.contains("-") match hyphens already in the element's own attributes (movement-none, text-slate, text-sm), so it can no longer detect the placeholder text node. Removing the "-" would still pass.
recommended_fix: Drop the vacuous line; the data-testid and aria-label assertions above already prove the none state renders. Or pin the text node specifically, e.g. assert the rendered string contains ">-<".
